messages.subject: "casewise" for fitted?
parts:
I noticed recently there is no 'casewise' argument for fitted.  I whipped up a quick function that I think does the trick, but, I wonder if this should be rolled into the fitted function at some point?

Hope some of you find this useful!

-Jarrett

getFittedLavaan <- function(obj){

resids <- residuals(obj, "casewise")

f <- obj@Data@X[[1]] + resids

as.data.frame(x)

}
